samples.title: 2011 Nhọrọ Senate nke Naijiria na Kaduna Steeti
samples.excerpt:
.Emere ntuli aka ndị Sineti nke afọ 2011 na Kaduna steeti n'abalị itoolu n'ọnwa Eprel, afọ 2011, iji họpụta ndị otu Sineti na Naijiria ga-anọchi anya steeti Kaduna.  Yusuf Datti Baba-Ahmed na-anọchi anya Kaduna North na Mohammed Saleh na-anọchite anya Kaduna Central meriri n'usoro Congress for Progressive Change, ebe Nenadi Usman nọchitere Kaduna South n'ọkwa ndị Peoples Democratic Party.

samples.title: Akwụkwọ Pickwick (ihe nkiri 1952)
samples.excerpt:
The Pickwick Papers bụ Ihe nkiri ihe nkiri na-atọ ọchị nke akụkọ ihe mere eme nke Britain nke afọ 1952 nke Noel Langley dere ma duzie na James Hayter, James Donald, Nigel Patrick na Joyce Grenfell. Ọ dabeere na akwụkwọ akụkọ Charles Dickens nke 1837 nke otu aha ahụ. Ọ bụ Renown Pictures mere ya bụ ndị wepụtara ihe nkiri Dickens ọzọ Scrooge n'afọ gara aga.

samples.title: Asha Khemka
samples.excerpt:
Dame Asha Khemka DBE DL (amụrụ n'ọnwa Ọktoba n'afọ 1951,  na Sitamarhi, Bihar)   bụ onye bụbu onye nkuzi nke gbara arụkwaghịm dị ka onye isi na onye isi oche na West Nottinghamshire College na ngwụcha afọ 2018 mgbe kọleji ahụ nwere nsogbu ego.    Ọ sonyeere kọleji na 2006, nọchiri Di McEvoy-Robinson. Tupu ọ gbaa arụkwaghịm n'ọnwa Ọktoba afọ 2018 ọ bụ otu n'ime ndị a na-akwụ ụgwọ kachasị elu na ngalaba ahụ. 


== Nsọpụrụ ==
E nyere Khemka ihe nrite OBE (Order of the British Empire) dị ka akụkụ nke 2009 New Year Honours, nke Elizabeth nke Abụọ, mgbe ahụ The Queen, gosipụtara na Buckingham Palace

samples.title: Hilda Tadria
samples.excerpt:
Hilda M. Tadria bụ onye na-ahụ maka ihe ndị ruuru ụmụ nwanyị na Uganda, ọkachamara na mmepe mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya, na onye isi nchịkwa nke Mentoring and Empowerment Programme for Young Women in Uganda (MEMPROW). Ọ na-adụ ndị NGO ọdụ n'ụwa niile gbasara okike, njikwa ụlọ ọrụ na mmepe mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya, ọ bụkwa osote prọfesọ na Mahadum Makerere.


== Oge ọ malitere ==
Tadria nwere nzere bachelọ na Sociology site na Mahadum Makerere, nzere mastas na Social Anthropology site na Newnham College, Cambridge, England, yana nzere PhD na Social Anthropology site na Mahadum Minnesota, US..
